questions.question: Use focus_lines in order to know Which country demonstrates the most remarkable improvement in female life expectancy from 1950 to 2023?

answer.value: China demonstrates the most remarkable improvement with a total increase of 35.20 years from 45.73 in 1950 to 80.93 in 2023, representing an average annual increase of 0.48 years

key_insights: China had the lowest starting life expectancy in 1950 at 45.73 years
China achieved the highest total increase of 35.20 years
China shows the fastest average annual growth rate of 0.48 years per year

reasoning.reasoning: Use focus_lines to highlight China and observe its dramatic life expectancy improvement over the 73-year period
